provenance: rubric and structure reference from 3_reproduction/L5/ (VASP+SOC band-offset run on the HPC cluster, reproduced 2026-06-21); see ../../../3_reproduction/L5/index.md and hpc_computations/RUN_RECORD.md. Ground truth = our as-run inputs, not the paper.
system: 1x1 commensurate R^X_h WS2/WSe2 heterobilayer, 6 atoms (W2 S2 Se2); WS2 lower, WSe2 upper; a_comm=3.235 A, c=29.54 A, 20 A vacuum along z

structure_match.note: Full structure match applies only to the relax label (the built bilayer). static/band carry the same built geometry as context for the SOC/band inputs, so they are graded by species+vacuum sanity only (their production geometry is the relax chain output, unavailable at input-writing time). method='fallback' (rigid-translation scan + nearest-same-species, no symmetry ops) is REQUIRED because this is a polar heterobilayer: method='matcher' wrongly PASSES a layer-z-swap (WS2/WSe2 exchanged top/bottom, disp 9.46 A) since a rigid layer swap is equivalent to the horizontal mirror in the hexagonal lattice point group (D6h), which StructureMatcher legitimately applies -- the polar-flip analogue of the hBN B/N-swap failure. fallback has no symmetry ops, so it fails the swap. Verified in selfcheck: fallback PASSES the correct R^X_h build and a translated+wrapped copy, and FAILS wrong-registry (R^h_h, no shift; disp 1.87 A), wrong-a_comm (3.17 A; lattice mismatch), and layer-z-swap (disp 9.46 A).

kmesh_reference.note: As-run reproduction mesh provenance. Grading uses the separate frozen kmesh_policy; centering and vacuum requirements remain independent.

encut_floor.note: 1.0 * max(ENMAX over W,S,Se) from grader_potcar_vasp54.yaml; S ENMAX 280 eV is the max; our as-run ENCUT is 520 eV

kpath.note: band-step line-mode KPOINTS must contain these three physical vertices; Reciprocal or Cartesian interpreted with the submitted lattice and POSCAR scale; existing tolerance 1e-3 per fractional component; segment order and extra vertices ungraded

incar_required.note: Each rule applies to the effective value: the tag if explicitly set, else the VASP default. Only the settings listed here are graded; the per-tag reasoning is in notes.md (C6).

relax.LSORBIT_false: LSORBIT effectively false (no SOC relaxation; omitted defaults to false)
relax.relax_fixed_cell: ISIF effectively in {0,1,2} (fixed cell; default 2) + IBRION in {1,2,3} + force-based EDIFFG<0 with |EDIFFG|<=0.05 eV/A
relax.NSW_ge_1: NSW >= 1 explicit (a static default 0 would not relax)
relax.ENCUT_floor: ENCUT >= the largest ENMAX over W,S,Se = 280 eV (the pseudopotential's own floor)
relax.ISMEAR_set: ISMEAR in {-5,0} (gapped system; 18x18x1 qualifies for -5, ours used 0)
relax.LASPH_true: LASPH = .TRUE. explicit (W 5d band edges; VASP default .FALSE.; our as-run decks set it -- handbook 5.2b easy-to-mistake tags)
relax.kmesh: Frozen automatic-default minima from kmesh_policy, with the separately specified centering, vacuum and method constraints.

static.ISYM_off: ISYM in {-1,0}; -1 disables symmetry entirely; 0 retains k/-k reduction (default 2 for PAW fails)
static.LORBIT_weights: LORBIT in {11,12,14} (per-site orbital weights; omitted fails)
static.LASPH_true: LASPH = .TRUE. explicit (W 5d band edges; VASP default .FALSE.; our as-run decks set it -- handbook 5.2b easy-to-mistake tags)
static.kmesh: Frozen automatic-default minima from kmesh_policy, with the separately specified centering, vacuum and method constraints.
static.poscar_species: W2 S2 Se2 (geometry sanity only; production geometry = relax chain)

band.ICHARG_11: ICHARG=11 (non-self-consistent, reads the static charge density; default 2)
band.LORBIT_weights: LORBIT in {11,12,14} (per-site orbital weights consumed downstream)
band.LASPH_true: LASPH = .TRUE. explicit (W 5d band edges; VASP default .FALSE.; our as-run decks set it -- handbook 5.2b easy-to-mistake tags)
band.kpath: line-mode vertices at physical Gamma, M, K; Reciprocal/Cartesian coordinates normalized to the submitted reciprocal basis

score: 1 only if the relax POSCAR matches the reference AND all three runs satisfy their REQUIRED INCAR/KPOINTS/POSCAR rubric (all checks must pass; any single failure scores 0)

kmesh_policy.source: Trusted reference input cell per run label; geometry-based density shared by VASP, QE and ABACUS. No inference from submitted settings.
kmesh_policy.rule: Each periodic-axis subdivision >= automatic default, without subtraction or relative margin. Vacuum axes are exactly 1. Berry strings retain their independent longitudinal condition.
